# Popover

> Content that pops up beside the element that opened it, in the top layer, and gets dismissed the way a native popover does.

`<slab-popover>` · Overlays · built on `[popover]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/popover/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/popover.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-popover placement="bottom">
  <button slot="anchor">Details</button>
  Anything that isn't a menu, a tooltip or a dialog.
</slab-popover>
```

Give it a `label` when it holds something you work in, such as a form or a few controls, rather than a few words about its anchor. It's then a non-modal dialog named by the label, and the anchor tells screenreaders it opens one with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`.

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                                 |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Enter, Space | On the anchor, opens or closes the popover, as a click does. |
| Escape       | Closes the popover and returns focus to the anchor.          |

## Elements

### `<slab-popover>`

Import `slab-elements/popover.js` to register it.

A popover with no visual styles, around a native `[popover="auto"]`, so it opens in the top layer and is dismissed the way one is: by Escape, by a click outside it, and by another popover opening. None of that is reimplemented here.

Its anchor, the element that opens it, is whatever is slotted into `anchor`. The obvious wiring is `popovertarget` or `commandfor`, which would also give the anchor its `aria-expanded` for free. Neither can reach across a shadow root, and the anchor is outside this one while the popover is inside. So a click on the anchor calls `showPopover({ source })` or `hidePopover()` instead. `source` gives the platform part of what `popovertarget` would: it makes the anchor the popover's implicit one for positioning, and focus goes back to it on close. The rest is done here, and is the reason this component is more than a slot: `aria-expanded` on the anchor, focus going back to it from slotted content (which the platform doesn't count as inside the popover), and a second click on the anchor closing the popover rather than light dismiss closing it and the click opening it again. A Slab anchor, such as a Copy Button, passes `aria-expanded` on to its own button.

`open` reflects whether the popover is open, however it got there or went away, and setting it opens or closes the popover. "beforetoggle" and "toggle" are the popover's own, dispatched again from the host because neither leaves the shadow root. Cancelling "beforetoggle" cancels the opening, as it does on a native popover.

Give it a `label` when what it holds is a dialog, such as a form or a set of controls, rather than a few words about its anchor. The popover is then a non-modal `role="dialog"` named by the label, the way react-aria's is, and its anchor gets `aria-haspopup="dialog"`. Without one, it's a plain container, read as content that follows its anchor.

Positioning is the one place it carries CSS beyond the bare minimum. Left to the browser, a popover is centered in the viewport, not by its anchor, which isn't a look so much as not working. So it's put beside its anchor with CSS anchor positioning and flipped when it would leave the screen. `placement` picks the side and nothing else: the gap, the alignment, and every other visual choice are left to `::part(popover)`. Where anchor positioning isn't supported, the popover falls back to the browser's centering.

#### Attributes

| Name        | Type                                     | Default    | Description                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`     | `string`                                 |            | Makes the popover a dialog named by it. Leave it unset when the popover only holds a few words about its anchor. |
| `open`      | `boolean`                                | `false`    | Whether it's open. Set it to open or close it.                                                                   |
| `placement` | `'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | The side of its anchor it opens on, when there's room. It flips when there isn't.                                |

#### Methods

| Signature                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `hide(): void`                     | Closes it.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `show(): void`                     | Opens it.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `toggle(force?: boolean): boolean` | Opens it when it's closed, and closes it when it's open, as a native popover's `togglePopover()` does. `true` only opens it and `false` only closes it. Returns whether it's open. |

#### Events

| Name           | Type          | Description                                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `beforetoggle` | `ToggleEvent` | Before it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` that doesn't bubble. Cancel it while it's opening to keep it closed.   |
| `toggle`       | `ToggleEvent` | When it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` with `oldState` and `newState` that doesn't bubble, as a popover's does. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description                     |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `anchor`  | `Element`           | What opens it, such as a button |
| (default) | `Element \| string` |                                 |

#### CSS parts

| Name      | Description           |
| --------- | --------------------- |
| `popover` | The popover's content |

#### CSS states

| Name           | Description      |
| -------------- | ---------------- |
| `:state(open)` | While it's open. |
